abstract: A mature cystic teratoma of the ovary occurred in a 51-year-old woman and recurred as a large intrahepatic tumor mass as well as a small mass in the transverse colon 17 years after rupture, intraperitoneal spillage of tumor contents and subtotal surgical removal of the ovarian lesion and peritoneal implants. The patient was treated with a partial hepatectomy and a segmental transverse colectomy. The recurrent lesions, which contained histologically fully mature teratomatous elements only, were excised; the result was a complete cure. To our knowledge this is the first documented report on such a complication of mature cystic teratoma of the ovary.
abstract_ja: 51歳の女性に卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が生じ、破裂、腫瘍内容物の腹腔内への漏出、卵巣病変および腹膜播種の亜全摘出の17年後に、大きな肝内腫瘤と横行結腸の小さな腫瘤として再発した。患者は部分肝切除術と横行結腸の区域切除術を受けた。再発病変は、完全に成熟した奇形腫成分のみを組織学的に含んでおり、切除の結果、完治した。我々の知る限り、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫によるこのような合併症の、文書化された最初の報告である。
